data.body_html:
Ring in 2027 with a Marbella New Year's Eve yacht charter that puts you front and centre for the best fireworks views over the Mediterranean. From Puerto Banús, you'll watch the sky explode over Marbella Bay while sipping cava on deck—no crowds, no queues, just 360° sea views. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on an Azimut 39 or Astondoa 40, all inclusive. Here's everything you need to know to secure your spot.

Why a Yacht Is the Best Seat for Marbella's New Year's Eve Fireworks

Marbella's midnight fireworks are launched from a barge off the coast between Puerto Banús and Marbella town. From land, you're competing for space along the Golden Mile or packed into beach clubs. On a private yacht, you anchor in the bay with an unobstructed view. The sound bounces off La Concha mountain behind you, and the reflection ripples across the water. Plus, you control the music, the drinks, and the company. It's the most exclusive way to celebrate.

Our Fleet for New Year's Eve 2027

We have boats for every group size and budget. All depart from Puerto Banús and include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and tax.

What's Included in the Price

Every New Year's Eve charter includes: licensed skipper, fuel, bottled water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You don't pay extra for the skipper or fuel. Just bring your party spirit and a jacket—December nights on the water can be cool (around 15°C).

Best Yachts for Different Groups

Couples or small groups (up to 9): The Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 at €749/2h are perfect. You get a private deck with a saloon and sunpad, plus space for a small table of canapés.
Friends or family (10-12 pax): The Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h) is the sweet spot—24 metres of deck space, a flybridge, and a free jet ski for a pre-fireworks thrill. The Azimut 58 Flybridge also works well if you want a flybridge for dancing.
Luxury celebrations: For a truly opulent night, the Ferretti 94 (29 m) or Canados 86 (26 m) offer multiple decks, a full crew, and catering options. Prices on request.

Typical New Year's Eve Itinerary

Most charters run 4 hours, from 10:00 pm to 2:00 am. You depart Puerto Banús, cruise along the Marbella coastline past the Golden Mile, and anchor near the fireworks barge around 11:30 pm. At midnight, the sky lights up—you can watch from the bow, the flybridge, or through the saloon windows. After the finale, you cruise back to port with cava in hand. For a longer evening, book 8 hours and add a sunset cruise to Estepona or Cabopino before the fireworks.

Booking Tips for New Year's Eve 2027

  • Book by mid-December: Yachts sell out fast. We recommend securing your slot by 1 December.
  • Check the weather: December averages 15-18°C. Bring a windproof jacket and deck shoes.
  • Bring decorations: You're welcome to bring banners, balloons, or a small tree. Just avoid open flames.
  • Catering: We can arrange a private chef or a catered menu on request. Ask via WhatsApp.
  • Deposit: 50% deposit to confirm, balance due 7 days before departure. Cancellations up to 14 days before are fully refundable.
